metadata.case_name: FUNG WAI HAN v. HUI CHIK KEUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: odd job worker in Shop 53 (dry goods shop)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: giving some tutorial lessons to children

source: The plaintiff brings this claim ... on 22 May 1999 in which the plaintiff was scalded by boiling congee resulting in 63% of her body suffering severe burns.
The report from the Department of Surgery of Prince of Wales Hospital states that the plaintiff was transferred to them on 22 May 1999 suffering from 63% deep burns.

injuries.description: Hypertrophic scars with contractures and scar bands causing restricted joint movement (notably both elbows and right thigh) and disfiguring pigmentation
injuries.body_part: trunk, bilateral upper limbs, bilateral thighs, buttock, neck, right wrist, groin
source: Hypertrophic scars developed gradually on all the involved areas and pressure therapy started in June 1999.

The occupational therapy report ... showed: (a) scars over the back ...; (b) scar over the left axilla ...; (c) scar over bilateral upper arms and forearms ...; (g) scar over bilateral thigh ...; (h) scar over the neck ...

Dr Ma: permanent unsightly scars over her back, lower abdomen, both upper limbs and both lower limbs gave her pain and irritation ... They also affected her normal limb movements such as full extension of elbows and squatting.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: Psychological injury: adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive mood; chronic PTSD and secondary mood/adjustment problems
source: Both experts are agreed that she suffers from an adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive mood.
Dr Frendi Li ... that the plaintiff has chronic PTSD and secondary mood and adjustment problems.

manifestations.description: Itching and pain from hypertrophic scars, worse in hot/humid weather
Pulling discomfort at both elbows when trying to straighten them; pain across elbow joints when carrying heavy weight
Walking for over 30 minutes causes stretching pain in the right thigh due to tight scar band
Difficulty squatting due to tight scar bands in front and behind right thigh; restriction of thigh muscle actions
Right wrist scar active and limited wrist movement
Unable to perform any further physical work; daily activities required continual assistance by family
Nightmares, reminders of accident, fears and avoidance of heat, avoidance of going out, loss of self-esteem and confidence

treatments_received: resuscitation and ambulance transfer to hospital
admission to Burns Unit, Prince of Wales Hospital
five operations to complete covering of wounds (during initial hospitalization)
pressure therapy and pressure garments with padding
silicone gel for right wrist scar
steroid injections (previous combined laser and kenalog therapy noted)
laser therapy (combined laser and kenalog; reported as not successful)
treatments_future: steroid injection treatment as recommended by Dr Chow (52 sessions)

losses.description: Permanent unsightly hypertrophic scarring causing cosmetic disfigurement, itching, pain and psychological stress
Breakdown of her marriage (husband effectively deserted her) and estrangement of her son

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of housekeeping ability (reduced ability to do housework; assessed and awarded for future loss)
Incapacitated from performing further physical work; unlikely to return to full-time pre-accident job; only able to resume some tutorial lessons

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fears and avoidance of heat and tendency to avoid going out because of social embarrassment and self-consciousness about conspicuous scars
Daily activities needed continual assistance from family during the recovery period
